sources.title: Ownr blog: sole proprietorship fee reduced to $49

keyLimits.en: Includes government filing fees; available in BC, Alberta, Ontario and Quebec.

Ranges roughly CAD 499-699 depending on province; includes corporate formation documents (director/shareholder resolutions, bylaws, share register) per third-party reporting, not independently confirmed on ownr.co in this session.

addOns.en: Ongoing compliance add-ons reported: an annual "Online Minute Book" plan and a "Managed Corporation" plan, priced in the low hundreds of CAD per year; exact current prices not independently confirmed on the official site in this session.

cautions.en: Pricing for incorporation and annual compliance plans could not be directly confirmed on ownr.co's own pricing page in this session; only the sole-proprietorship fee ($49 CAD) was confirmed via an official Ownr blog post.

capabilities.en: Online business registration and incorporation for Canadian entrepreneurs (sole proprietorship, partnership, corporation).
Generates corporate formation documents (director/shareholder resolutions, bylaws) as part of incorporation.

limitations.en: Service coverage is limited to specific Canadian provinces (confirmed: BC, Alberta, Ontario, Quebec for sole proprietorship).
Only serves Canadian business registration; not usable for businesses outside Canada.

unknowns: Could not load ownr.co's own pricing page directly in this session (content returned empty); current incorporation and compliance-plan prices come from third-party review sites and need re-verification against the official pricing page.
